set.body: Acceptance criteria: implement the published five-point velocity denominator of 6 times the regular sample interval; the linear-ramp fixture returns the hand-computed physical velocity; irregular timing is rejected or routed through a separately named estimator or resampling operation; thresholds, lambda, and minimum samples are validated at construction; gaps cannot contribute velocity; reported peak velocity agrees with the designated reference fixture; the half-scale mutant fails.
set.title: Correct Engbert-Kliegl kinematics and certify physical velocity
